eyebrow.zh: 把 KV 张量、块映射与架构信息保存为磁盘快照，在恢复前校验内容。
eyebrow.en: Store KV tensors, block mappings and architecture metadata as a disk snapshot and verify content before restoration.

headline.zh: 让 KV 张量快照可保存、可检查。

sub.zh: 把 KV 张量、块映射与架构信息保存为磁盘快照，在恢复前校验内容。
sub.en: Store KV tensors, block mappings and architecture metadata as a disk snapshot and verify content before restoration.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: manifest 保留架构与 blob 信息。
body.en: The manifest preserves architecture and blob metadata.

body.zh: 读取前检查磁盘内容哈希。
格式往返不依赖运行中的模型。
body.en: Format round trips do not need a running model.

body.zh: 缓存状态只有在进程内时，难以独立检查它保存了哪些张量、是否损坏、能否读回。KVSnap 把这些信息组成一个自描述目录，用 manifest 描述 blob，并提供保存、校验和恢复接口。
body.en: In-process cache state is hard to inspect independently: which tensors were saved, are they intact and can they be read back? KVSnap packages that state as a self-describing directory with a manifest, blobs and save, verify and restore interfaces.

body.zh: 以 seed=42 创建小型合成 CPU KV 张量，走真实磁盘格式与校验路径，再恢复到新后端并逐张量比较。没有运行模型、GPU 或百万 token 上下文。
body.en: Seed=42 creates small synthetic CPU KV tensors, exercises the real disk format and integrity checks, then restores into a fresh backend and compares tensors. No model, GPU or million-token context is run.

alt.zh: 以 seed=42 创建小型合成 CPU KV 张量，走真实磁盘格式与校验路径，再恢复到新后端并逐张量比较。没有运行模型、GPU 或百万 token 上下文。
alt.en: Seed=42 creates small synthetic CPU KV tensors, exercises the real disk format and integrity checks, then restores into a fresh backend and compares tensors. No model, GPU or million-token context is run.

body.zh: KVCacheBackend 暴露 extract/inject。checkpoint 写入 manifest、逐层 K/V blob 与 block_map；verify 重算 xxhash64；restore 验证后读回张量并注入后端。InMemoryBackend 支持 CPU 往返验证，VLLMBackend 直接依赖特定引擎内部属性，接入需要单独验证。
body.en: KVCacheBackend exposes extract/inject. checkpoint writes a manifest, per-layer K/V blobs and block_map; verify recomputes xxhash64; restore verifies, reads tensors and injects them into a backend. InMemoryBackend supports CPU round-trip checks. VLLMBackend directly depends on engine internals and requires separate integration validation.

body.zh: CLI 的 list/info/verify 面向磁盘目录。save --mock 和 restore --mock 用于 CPU 示例；程序 API 可嵌入服务进程。serve 包装提供 SIGUSR1 保存与启动恢复入口，但不能从 CPU 演示推导其在任意模型或硬件上的可用性。
body.en: CLI list/info/verify operate on disk directories. save --mock and restore --mock exercise the CPU example; the Python API can be embedded in a serving process. The serve wrapper exposes SIGUSR1 saving and startup restoration, whose model and hardware compatibility cannot be inferred from the CPU demo.

body.zh: 默认目录为 `.kvsnap`，默认会话名为 default。manifest 记录模型 ID、层数、KV 头数、head_dim、dtype、块数、序列长度、前缀哈希以及每个 blob 的形状和 xxhash64。`config.py` 定义格式与 vLLM 目标版本。xxhash 用于内容校验，不是签名或加密。
body.en: The default directory is `.kvsnap` and session is default. The manifest records model ID, layers, KV heads, head_dim, dtype, blocks, sequence length, prefix hash and each blob’s shape and xxhash64. config.py defines the format and vLLM target version. xxhash is a content check, not a signature or encryption.

note.zh: 以 seed=42 创建小型合成 CPU KV 张量，走真实磁盘格式与校验路径，再恢复到新后端并逐张量比较。没有运行模型、GPU 或百万 token 上下文。
note.en: Seed=42 creates small synthetic CPU KV tensors, exercises the real disk format and integrity checks, then restores into a fresh backend and compares tensors. No model, GPU or million-token context is run.

body.zh: 两层、三个块，共五个 blob；K/V 与块映射全部相等。
body.en: Two layers and three blocks produce five blobs; K/V tensors and the block map are equal.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+、uv 和 PyTorch。源码默认安装即可运行 CPU 示例；实际 vLLM 接入另需对应引擎与硬件环境。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+, uv and PyTorch. The default source install runs the CPU example; actual vLLM integration additionally needs the corresponding engine and hardware.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/kvsnap.git
cd kvsnap
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: 未验证 GLM、昇腾、海光或特定 vLLM 版本；不声称秒级恢复或免除某个规模的 prefill。
limitations.en: GLM, Ascend, Hygon and specific vLLM versions were not validated; no second-scale restore or prefill savings are claimed.

limitations.zh: 当前适配器使用内部属性与部分推断状态；投入真实服务前必须检查调度器、前缀和块表契约。
limitations.en: The adapter uses internal attributes and partially inferred state; inspect scheduler, prefix and block-table contracts before real serving use.
